subject: FW: Proposal: Deal-aligned GPU sprint window and commitment matrix
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Li <ava.li@hyperai.com>, cloud-sales@stratuscloud.com, purchasing@titan-oem.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Deal-aligned GPU sprint window and commitment matrix

Ava / Stratus / Titan team —

Following our call last week, attaching a proposed approach that ties the HyperAI committed ramp to a 3-phase sprint window. High level:

- Phase A (onramp + staging): 6 weeks from order, smaller reserved pool for QA and acceptance tests.
- Phase B (customer go-live): 10–12 weeks from order, bulk of the committed GPUs go live.
- Phase C (buffer & scale): trailing 4–8 weeks for buffer and SKU rebalancing; cloud backstop engaged if OEM slots slip.

What we need from each vendor this week:
- Stratus: a windowed quote that includes an explicit hold/backfill credit if cloud capacity is provided later than Phase B expectation. Please include per-GPU hourly pricing for reserved vs burst.
- Titan (OEM): confirmed lead-time CSV by SKU (we need factory slot dates and earliest shipping week).
- HyperAI: confirmation on target go-live date and any hard gates for compliance/regulatory readiness.

I’ve attached a draft quote template and the Titan SKU spreadsheet request. I’d like to finalize mutual action plan (MAP) and signatures by next Tue so procurement can lock tranche 1.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102

Attachments: Stratus_windowed_quote_v2.pdf (pdf, 72KB); Titan_SKU_leadtime.csv (csv, 8KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Li <ava.li@hyperai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, cloud-sales@stratuscloud.com, purchasing@titan-oem.com
Date: 2027-08-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Deal-aligned GPU sprint window and commitment matrix

Ben —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple of technical / ops asks from my side before we lock dates:

1) Can Titan provide per-shipment gate checks (e.g., firmware flash windows + earliest customs-clear week)? We need those to align the staging pool cutoff.
2) Stratus: please call out warm pool vs cold reserve behavior. For Phase A we need <150ms p99 on a small batch; if Stratus warm pool can’t guarantee that under cold-start conditions we’ll need an interim dedicated staging cluster.
3) Vanessa/Marissa — what’s our minimum tranche size for internal capacity billing? I think 48 GPUs makes the math clean, but we should confirm.

If vendors can return the SKU lead-time and windowed quote by EOD Fri I’ll draft the MAP with technical acceptance criteria included.

- Karthik
Head of Platform Capacity, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Titan Procurement <purchasing@titan-oem.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, cloud-sales@stratuscloud.com
Date: 2027-08-28T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Deal-aligned GPU sprint window and commitment matrix

Ben / Karthik —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is the Titan_SKU_leadtime.csv you requested and a short note on slot cadence. Summary:

- SKU A1 (dense compute): earliest factory slot we can commit is week-of 2027-10-04, estimated ship-to-port 2027-10-18, customs + inland ~2 weeks depending on port. Lead-time variance +/- 3 weeks based on current order book.
- SKU B3 (mixed perf): earliest shipment week 2027-09-20, ship-to-port 2027-10-03.
- We can prioritize one tranche (48 units) for earlier build if contract signed and deposit received by 2027-09-01 — this will shift earliest ship by ~2 weeks earlier.

We don’t include firmware flash in the standard lead-time; that’s a 3–5 business-day ops step we can schedule in our factory or do at staging. Please note: given current OEM queue the +/- 3 week variance is realistic.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement, Titan OEM
purchasing@titan-oem.com

Date: 2027-08-28T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Deal-aligned GPU sprint window and commitment matrix

Team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Titan — the SKU dates are helpful and the tranche acceleration option is valuable. Next steps I’ll own this afternoon:

- Karthik: I’ll inline your technical acceptance clauses into the MAP and mark firmware flash as a scheduled ops milestone (factory option + staging fallback).
- Stratus: can you return the windowed quote (with backfill credit language) by EOD tomorrow? That will let us decide whether to rely on cloud backstop or request an early 48-GPU tranche from Titan.
- HyperAI (Ava): please confirm whether the compliance/go-live date remains 2027-11-15 or if you foresee shifts; that date drives which tranche we must accelerate.

I’ll circulate a one-page MAP (signature-ready) by Mon morning. If anyone needs a quick sync today I’m available 4:30–5:00 PT.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102
